lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Mn2Sb2 (reduced formula Mg6MnSb) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mn and Sb centers have 10 neighbors each, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.04 to 3.44 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, plus edge-sharing between Mn- and Mg-centered 10-vertex polyhedra.
